subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Theranos: A Board That Didn't Ask
description: A quick, practical guide to Theranos: A Board That Didn't Ask.

hook.text: Theranos promised a revolution in blood testing. The board included Henry Kissinger but no one from medicine.

buildup.text: Elizabeth Holmes stacked the board with celebrities, politicians, and generals — none with healthcare expertise.

discovery.text: The technology never worked. Patients received false test results that affected medical decisions.

twist.text: A prestigious board gave Theranos credibility. That credibility was the real product, not the technology.

climax.text: Theranos showed that a famous board without relevant expertise is worse than no board at all.

punchline.text: Famous board. No expertise. Nobody asked the right questions.

quiz.question: What was wrong with Theranos's board?
options: It lacked members with relevant healthcare expertise
It had too many medical doctors
It was too small to be effective
